$Comment: The Stone dungeon kit, piece Level_1_Walls: every prefab under Dungeon.Stone.Level_1.Walls, 1 interchangeable variant.
Imported from vanilla's cave-node graph Dungeons/Dungeon (2 nodes use this pool) by tools/rooms/import_kit.py. Re-run the importer when Hytale changes the kit instead of editing this file.
Each door is a doorway vanilla's graph joins to another piece; a door only meets a door of its own Kind, and one left open takes a Cap room of that Kind.
Vanilla pastes these pieces into solid rock, so Fill (Rock_Stone) fills the cells a piece leaves unlisted inside its Box.
As a Cap it carries, key by key, every tag value of the rooms whose doors it can close.
